description.value:
When fate hangs in the balance, you abandon caution and push your wizardry to its absolute limit.

When you use a Desperate Action to cast a spell, you gain the following benefits:

  • Your Charge Limit for this casting of the spell is increased by 1.
  • You can choose to take a level of @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.ERBR3AG01H4N1L91]{Exhaustion} to reduce the spell’s base mana cost to 0.

system.requirements: Must have a Wizard Adept Ability
